description:
Listed building consent: demolition of a 1960s breezeblock lean-to extension and Victorian toilet block, and works of
refurbishment and repair to the Old Pye House.
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Demolition work shall be carried out by hand tools or by tools held in the hand, other than power driven tools.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building. </span></span></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Brick footing to the timber frame&nbsp;shall reuse some of the bricks approved for removal.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">No development above ground works (slab level) for the new build is to commence until the works of repair, refurbishment to Old Pye House granted in the planning permission and Listed Building Consent is undertaken in full, as well as having undertaken <span style="color:#333333">completion of all measured surveys and photographic recording</span>.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Reason: To preserve the special interest of the Listed Building</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Details for the following features of Old Pye House shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works:</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">a) windows</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">b) doors</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">c) external materials</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">d) internal materials</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Reason: To preserve the special interest of the Listed Building.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt">Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, details of the proposed works to the sixteenth century brickwork on the north wall of the building shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Authority, in consultation with Historic England, before the relevant works to the sixteenth century brickwork are carried out. Those details shall include a report that sets out options for the retention, rebuilding, or reuse of the sixteenth century brickwork and provide a clear rationale for the preferred option. The report shall include a heritage-accredited engineer’s own full and first-hand assessment of the options.</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">Reason: To preserve the special interest of the Listed Building.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">A full photographic and textual recording report of the Listed Building (and any parts approved for removal) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in four stages:</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">a) prior to works (please note, just a full set of existing photos required for part a)</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">b) following removal of parts approved for removal (to include evidence during dismantling) and before repair works to the timber frame.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">c) after repair works to the timber frame.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">d) following completion of all works and prior to the use of the building. </span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The submitted report is required to include evidence gained during all stages of the application and implementation of this consent including evidence of fabric removed and be to a Level 3 standard indicated in the Historic England guidance document <em>Understanding Historic Buildings: A Guide to Good Recording Practice</em> (Historic England, May 2016) with final document submitted to the Greater London Historic Environment Record and Harrow Archives.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">REASON: To help protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">During the works, if hidden historic features are revealed they shall be retained in-situ. Works shall be halted in the relevant area of the building and the Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately. Failure to do so may result in unauthorised works being carried out and an offence being committed.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Before the start of works of repair to the timber frame a detailed Timber Decay Report and Method Statement with full particulars of the proposals for the treatment, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved Method Statement.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Suitable precautions shall be taken to secure and protect features against accidental loss or damage during the building work hereby granted, and no such features may be disturbed or removed, temporarily or permanently, except as indicated on the approved drawings or with the prior approval in writing of the local planning authority.<br>REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">If previously unknown evidence is discovered about historic character which would be affected by the works hereby granted, an appropriate record, together with recommendations for dealing with it in the context of the scheme, shall be approved in writing by the local planning authority before any of the permitted works are begun. The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.<br>REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">ll new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and to material, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent.<br>REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p>
